data.name: Ever Ready
data.description: Whenever you make an attack of opportunity, you gain a +%1 bonus on the attack roll and damage roll. You can make attacks of opportunity while flat-footed, even if you don't have the Combat Reflexes feat. At 3rd, 6th, and 9th tier, the number of attacks of opportunity you can make each round increases by one.|MythicLevel
